name: Frame Forge
description: A branded control deck for practice macros, empirical timing tools, speed/audio controls and procedural level creation.

click-sounds.name: Input sound effects
click-sounds.description: Uses press.ogg and release.ogg in the mod save folder; otherwise click.ogg.

speed-enabled.name: Enable practice speed control
speed-enabled.description: Practice Mode only. Does not change normal-mode speed.

music-sync.name: Match music rate to practice speed
music-sync.description: Rate matching, not a pitch-preserving time stretcher or drift corrector. Set Audio speed to 1 for matched timing.

audio-speed.name: Additional music speed multiplier
audio-speed.description: Changes speed AND pitch. Values other than 1 intentionally offset sync.

replay-file.name: Replay filename (blank = current/latest)
replay-file.description: A .fmacro filename in the mod save folder. No folder paths.

probe-radius.name: Window: test offsets plus/minus ticks
probe-radius.description: Each candidate needs a real retry from the start. Reports sampled survival, not an exact jump window.

probe-horizon.name: Window: survival horizon after press
probe-horizon.description: The fixed horizon includes the positive test radius. Record at least this long after the selected press.

build-x.name: Generator: starting design X
build-x.description: Generated objects use native editor paste placement. Actual insertion is relative to your editor view.

build-count.name: Generator: layout blocks / glow count
build-count.description: Layout uses 16..240 blocks. Decorative generation caps this at 200.

decoration-seed.name: Procedural decoration seed
decoration-seed.description: Auto decorate generates a repeatable flowing glow composition with rhythmic size accents. This is procedural, not AI. Import AI plan uses the separate local-model helper.
